key_insight: GMMag generates crystal structures with site-resolved magnetic moments and redirects sampling toward chemical and magnetic targets without retraining.
engineering_relevance: Targeted generation and finite-budget yield prediction could help allocate screening effort toward magnetic materials with previously unrepresented chemical formulas.
method: Conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and transformer decoder.
Gaussian-mixture sampling to retarget chemical and magnetic outputs.
Model repeated-formula generation to predict accumulation of distinct qualifying formulas.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates architecture, magnetic-moment representations and sampling choices, tests yield prediction in two separate ten-million-draw runs, and identifies Nd-containing candidates with negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
watch_item: Higher screening pass rates do not necessarily produce more distinct qualifying formulas, and predicted candidates still require further validation.
paper_title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
